evidence.observation: The opening viewport identifies Jamie, the Technical Project Manager–Product Operations & Implementation target, the operating-structure value proposition, and direct paths to work, resume, and contact.

The revised opening names Jamie as the actor and translates his work into plans, visible risks, decision and status records, onboarding, launch support, and durable handoffs before mapping those capabilities to named projects.
The 2x revenue result is expressly framed as a contribution during Jamie's long-term systems work; causal ownership and private operational evidence are not claimed.

Jamie's planning, documentation, and presenter roles remain distinct from Board and Council decisions, and the page states that appropriation does not prove receipt, expenditure, agreement execution, or construction.
The event chronology, Council attribution, independent follow-on, press coverage, and archived unofficial status resolve to bounded local references with accessible backlinks.
Canonical claims and references distinguish Jamie's founding, organizing, documentation, and web contributions from coalition leadership and collective legislative outcomes.
Descriptive headings and direct agency make the case navigable, but its length, stacked canonical claims, and repeated public/private boundary explanations impose meaningful scanning effort.

Jamie is clearly the builder of the independent prototype, and the resident-facing outcome is translated into plain language without implying an official service, hackathon victory, or present-day guidance.

The sourced Council appropriation is stated directly without making Jamie responsible for municipal decisions or unproven downstream funding stages; the claim-heavy presentation keeps the page short of exceptional editorial ease.
Artistic experimentation, installations, gatherings, participation, memory, and place remain connected to Jamie's present systems practice, although few material or visual specimens are available.
The case connects civic records, issue modeling, interface design, and resident action, but the recursive physical-digital method is more often described than visually demonstrated.

Artifact cards describe the interface, translation layer, and press record in text, but no approved project image or inspectable visual artifact is rendered; this remains a declared application-profile deferral and production gap.
The role title, operating-structure proposition, selected impact, application PDF path, and corrected CallNYC chronology reinforce the public portfolio narrative.

Candidate-bound evidence reports 200 responses across 11 desktop and mobile routes, no reflow overflow, visible focus for all 24 traversed controls, working citations, and usable server-rendered content on all 11 routes with JavaScript disabled; the 200% result uses an equivalent viewport rather than browser-chrome zoom.
Canonical, Open Graph, Twitter-card, resume-download, and contact paths are coherent, while the inspected candidate intentionally retains staging metadata defaults.

Repository, route, local browser, accessibility, metadata, and resume checks support application use; matching production deployment, smoke, indexing, monitoring, rollback, and human-approval evidence remain explicitly deferred.

The employment-acceptance contract adds six current role contexts, requirement-level fit and gap records, title-blind discovery controls, reader-specific simulated judgments, and exact-candidate binding without weakening public-safety gates or closing visual, production, rights, or human-approval gaps.

The refreshed public registry adds two useful boundaries to existing NYC Artist Coalition claims: protected operating records do not establish Jamie's authorship or every completed task, and prepared testimony drafts do not establish verbatim delivery or independently verify every metric. No visible portfolio copy or claim strength increased.

smallestDefensiblePatch: Replace one text-only CallNYC artifact card with one approved public-safe image of the surviving issue-pathway interface, with concise alt text and a caption limited to what the image proves while preserving the archived, unofficial-status boundary.
